column1: # p291 — 2026-10-18 — ACTION p291: A SUBMODULE GRANT IS VERIFIED **AT THE PIN**.
# 🔵 What p290 left and what this discharges.  p290 built the submodule-boundary axis on
# TWO of seven segments and declared the other five UNPROBED — its own ranked item 1.
# All seven are probed here, and the five it called "OUT-OF-SCOPE (not an education
# segment)" are re-graded: see `evidence/segment-education-surface.2026-10-18-p291.tsv`.
# 🔴 AND THE RULE ITSELF IS CORRECTED.  p290 read each submodule at HEAD and then checked
# HEAD == pin.  `raw.githubusercontent.com` serves a payload AT AN ARBITRARY COMMIT, so the
# pinned SHA is directly readable and HEAD is not an input at all.  p290's rule reports
# "cannot verify" for a submodule whose HEAD has merely moved on — wrong in the RESTRICTIVE
# direction, which is the dangerous one: it invites a later pass to re-probe at HEAD and
# publish the licence at HEAD rather than the licence the superproject pins.  A studio
# running `git clone --recurse-submodules` receives THE PIN.
# 🟢 CHANNEL.  Every `payload_sha256_12` below is a payload THIS PASS read at the pinned SHA
# over `raw.githubusercontent.com` (200 on 7/7).  The gitlinks were re-derived blind by
# `git ls-tree HEAD` on a fresh clone and reproduce p290's seven exactly.
# 🔴 `api.github.com` and `github.com` HTML both answer 403 from here; no star count is
